messages:
lee: Quick thread to finalize the changelog bullets for the docs site release (v0.11.0). I put a draft in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900.
ana: I'll tidy the bullets and add a 'what changed for integrators' section. Keep it to 3-5 concise items.
chris: Adding two tiny SDK snippets (py/js) and a one-line migration note: streaming default changed. Snippets will be single-line call examples.
link-bot: Found 2 broken anchors: guides/rollouts.md#canary -> guides/rollouts.md#canary-deploy and examples/prefix-cache.md gist link expired.
ana: I'll update anchors and host the small example in repo instead of gist.
lee: Include Known Issues: 1) embeddings 429 under sustained high concurrency with Dedicated burst; 2) short transient 502s in private deploys during canary shift. Add mitigation notes.
chris: For embeddings 429 add repro: `wrk -t8 -c150 -d30s /v1/embeddings` and suggest client-side retries/backoff.
docs-bot: CI queued for PR. Expect link-check + snippet-linter results in ~5m.
lee: OK. If CI passes I'll merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and send the one-line announcement. Draft TL;DR: "v0.11.0: improved streaming and batching, minor SDK tweaks; see migration notes."
ana: LGTM, pushing small anchor fixes now.
link-bot: CI: link-check OK, snippet-lint OK.
lee: Perfect. Assign reviews: @ana @chris. Merge if no objections by 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
